label: benediction picture: fighter fields
why: The picture's own state on the fighter (the ring contracts 0.3s past ultHalo; 'a foe inside' holds through a hit stop; the tag flags); never m.ultFx (open item 25). Read by nothing in the sim.

label: benediction picture: the presentation call
why: tickPresentation runs through hit stops and after the match; one call to tickBenediction.

label: benediction picture: tickBenediction
why: Drives the ring (expand 0.3s at the cast; contract 0.3s at a clock close, a death or the verdict), 'inside' from tickHalo's own tally (frames/inFrames rising), the 0.4 -> 0.7 brightening, and the tag rule (first smite / first blessing of each inside stretch, found by haloTally.smite / .bless rising). Writes presentation fields, tags and taught only; no rng.

label: benediction picture: the floor call (world, under both balls)
why: World pass under both balls, source-over: the ring, the wash, the motes and the foe's rim (bloom share 0; no ball's disc can be painted over).

label: benediction picture: the drawing methods
why: drawBenediction and one method a component (geometry, wash, ring, motes, rim).

label: benediction picture: the beam's lit ground retired
code:
/* ---- Benediction's lit ground was the BEAM's (a 150-unit pool at the
       target for the cast's 1.6); retired with it (v82, v110 stage 6). The
       halo is `drawBenediction`, off the fighter, where the one ultFx slot
       cannot erase it; the cast's record now carries the CAST only and
       nothing draws from it. */
why: drawUltUnder's aureole branch was the BEAM's lit ground at the target for every cast's 1.6; the beam is out (v110 stage 1), so its picture goes too.

label: benediction picture: the beam's lance retired
code:
/* ---- Benediction's lance and its rings were the BEAM's (sent out along
       the shot line, the heal's rings closing into the caster); retired with
       it (v82, v110 stage 6). The cast is the ring growing out of the ball
       (`drawBenediction`). */
why: drawUltOver's aureole branch was the BEAM's lance along the shot line, the rings at the target and the heal's rings into the caster; retired with the beam.

label: benediction picture: the charge rune
why: ULTSIG.aureole drew the beam's shaft through a halo; now the halo round the ball, the monstrance's six rays and motes drifting in, brightening as the charge fills.

label: benediction picture: the cast record's life
why: The ultFx life entry 1.6 was the beam's set-piece length; with nothing drawn from the slot the cast's record falls to the map's own 1.5. The narrowest anchor, so Consecration's entry on the same line is left for its own build.
